question: Should ClawHub adopt a 40-character skill display-name limit with hosted and GitHub-backed legacy-name grandfathering?
rationale: The linked issue asks for concise titles but does not specify the exact cap, and this PR changes stored catalog compatibility behavior for already-published skills.

options.title: Adopt 40 with grandfathering
options.body: Accept the proposed product policy after the exact-limit sync bug is fixed and real behavior proof is posted.

options.title: Choose a different cap
options.body: Ask the contributor to update the shared constant, UI copy, backend checks, and tests to the maintainer-selected maximum.

options.title: Defer the policy
options.body: Keep the issue open and close or pause this PR until maintainers are ready to define title-length policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt 40 with grandfathering
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed product policy after the exact-limit sync bug is fixed and real behavior proof is posted.
